versions.changelog: Add comprehensive FAQ/Troubleshooting section (8 common issues): drawtext/libass missing, ffmpeg expression syntax, hardware encoder failures, CJK font rendering, Whisper download in China, pip mirrors, WSL setup

Fix chapter timeline bar: correct drawtext syntax, add --style mono (monochrome) option, thicker bar for visibility, graceful fallback without drawtext. Tested all combinations: landscape/portrait x color/mono x 2/5 chapters.

Add chapter timeline bar: auto-generates chapters from transcript, renders colored segment bar with animated playhead, chapter titles with fade-in/out, landscape (bottom) / portrait (top) adaptive positioning, YouTube-compatible timestamps output

Add cross-platform support (macOS/Linux/WSL/Windows), GPU hardware acceleration (NVENC/VideoToolbox/QSV/AMF), faster-whisper engine (4x faster), auto model selection, China mirror support, Apple Silicon optimization
Initial release: auto video editing with speech recognition, sentence splitting, subtitle burning, clip merging, and cover generation
